compose_preprocessing_pipeline: compose a pipeline of lipreading preprocessing transforms like Normalize, CenterCrop, and HorizontalFlip
convert_video_frames_to_grayscale: convert a sequence of RGB video frames to grayscale using RgbToGray transform
normalize_video_frames: normalize video frames with given mean and standard deviation values
crop_video_frames_center: crop video frames to a specified size from the center using CenterCrop transform
add_snr_noise_to_audio_signal: add controlled SNR noise to an audio signal using AddNoise with configurable noise levels
